about: White Day: A Labyrinth Named School is a classic Korean horror game, developed by Korean company Sonnori.

The story starts off with our main character, Hee-Min Lee, who is sneaking into his school at night to give a girl he is secretly beloved with a White Day chocolate. Unfortunately, the school at night was not as ordinary as it was in the day. Hee-Min Lee encounters various frightening supernatural phenomena’s and myths if the school. To escape from deadly traps and being trapped in this labyrinth named school, Hee-Min Lee must save other trapped students and escape together. Your every choice, will affect your ending!
summary: White Day: A Labyrinth Named School is a classic Korean horror game, developed by Korean company Sonnori.
